name: suite-env-prefix-refused
body: Two limits. (1) Env-prefixed suite commands (APG_SUITE_E2E=1 bun test ...) are refused by the implementer's shell grant, so an ad-hoc opt-in suite run must either use Bun's automatic .env autoload in opencode-suite/ or, preferably, the gate script (scripts/gate.sh --e2e), which exports APG_SUITE_E2E itself. Limit: a one-off opt-in suite case cannot be run with a direct env-prefixed invocation, and because the gate runs the boundary e2e only after the cargo e2e tier, any cargo-e2e failure aborts the gate before that step and leaves the boundary e2e unexercised with no independent entry point. Upgrade when the shell grant admits env-prefixed commands (obsoleting the .env workaround) or when a gate flag runs only the suite e2e. (2) The gate runs the suite's tests but no parse or type check over `opencode-suite/tools/**`, so an edit to a tool's description string is checked only by whichever test module happens to import it — `apg_node.ts` is imported by no suite test, so its descriptions are unparsed by the gate. Upgrade by adding a bun-built TS check over the tools tree when the gate is next touched.
